title: Return Charges Rate Table for Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
These rates price the charges that may arise when a vehicle bought under Vehicle Purchase Agreements comes back under the Kestrel 7-Day Return.

| Vehicle program | Excess-mileage fee per mile above the allowance | Home pickup fee for the returned vehicle | Damage waiver (repair estimate of new damage up to which no damage charge is made) | Charge per missing key or fob | Documentation fee refunded on a completed return |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Value Line | $0.50 | $199.00 | $100.00 | $150.00 | Yes |
| Kestrel Inspected | $0.50 | $199.00 | $100.00 | $150.00 | Yes |
| Kestrel Certified | $0.35 | $99.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 | Yes |
| Kestrel Certified Plus | $0.35 | $0.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 | Yes |
| Kestrel Premium Certified | $0.25 | $0.00 | $500.00 | $400.00 | Yes |
| Kestrel Factory Certified | $0.25 | $0.00 | $500.00 | $350.00 | Yes |

**Notes.**
- The pickup fee is for Kestrel collecting the returned vehicle from the customer's address; there is no fee for a hub drop-off.
- The missing key charge applies to each key or fob that was delivered with the vehicle and is missing at return.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Kestrel Factory Certified vehicle returned by home pickup with one of its two delivered keys missing carries a $350.00 key charge and no pickup fee; the same return on a Kestrel Certified vehicle carries a $250.00 key charge and a $99.00 pickup fee.
